_comment: Ambrose Nettlewick, the cauldron warlock (SLICE_PLAN 3.8, kit sheet docs/heroes-v2/kits/ambrose_nettlewick.txt). The kit fields are the slice fixture's (src/test/resources/heroes/slice/ambrose_nettlewick.json); art and animations are source only (HEROES_V2 12.5, 12.6). One body for good (the owner's rule of 2026-11-13, HEROES_V2 3.6): an adult of ordinary size, slim build, drawn at 100%.
name: Ambrose Nettlewick
title: the Cauldron Warlock
description: A cheerful, absent-minded potion scholar who treats every fight as an experiment.

moves.name: Great Brew
moves.line: Big one coming, please don't interrupt!

weak_points.hint: Big one coming, please don't interrupt!

transition.line: Time for the big one. Please don't interrupt.

intro.line: Ah, a test subject! I mean, a guest. Hold still, please.

quirks: names every potion after the person it was tested on

leader.title: Archivist of the Nettlewick Conclave
leader.motto: Hypothesis: we win. Let us test it.

founding: Welcome to the Nettlewick Conclave! Please do not drink anything labelled 'maybe'.
greeting: {player}! Perfect timing, I need someone to hold this. Don't sniff it.
escape: Experiment concluded! Result: I should leave. Don't touch my notes!
fallen: Fascinating... so that is what it feels like. Noted.

amb.hex_trace._comment: Hex Mark's tell: the left hand raised before his chest, two fingers up, tracing the sign; the chest turned a little to his right, the eyes on the target over the hand.

amb.hex_cock._comment: Hex Mark, cocked: the hand drawn back beside his left cheek, fingers up and forward, the chest wound to his right.

amb.hex_flick._comment: Hex Mark's release: the left arm flung out straight at the target, the fingers spread and pointing, the chest unwound to his left.

amb.bar_reach._comment: Potion Barrage: the left hand across at the bandolier, plucking a vial from its loop, the head dipped to look.

amb.bar_wind._comment: Potion Barrage, the swing back: the vial drawn back low past his left hip, the chest turned to his left, the eyes kept on the target.

amb.bar_lob._comment: Potion Barrage, the lob: the left arm swung through forward and up, the vial leaving his fingers at chest height, the chest turned to his right.

amb.bar_follow._comment: Potion Barrage, the follow-through: the empty hand carried on up, the fingers spread.

amb.bar_fumble._comment: Potion Barrage's recovery, reaching for new vials: the left hand patting along the bandolier, the head bowed over it, the shoulders hunched.

amb.cau_raise._comment: Cauldron's tell: the staff raised high in the right hand to his right front, the cauldron swung up above his head height, the knees softened, the eyes up on it.

amb.cau_heave._comment: Cauldron's release: the staff swung forward and down in both hands, the cauldron out before him at chest height so the brew flies at the target, the weight forward over bent knees.

amb.cau_follow._comment: Cauldron's follow-through: the staff dipped on, the cauldron swinging low before him.

amb.fume_crouch._comment: Fume Step's tell: down on bent knees, a vial snatched up in the left hand to his shoulder.

amb.fume_smash._comment: Fume Step's release: the vial dashed down at his feet, the left arm flung down before him.

amb.fume_hop._comment: Fume Step's hop back: the knees tucked up under him, the body leaning forward over them as the hop carries him back, the left arm out for balance, a hand waving the fumes away.

amb.fume_land._comment: Fume Step's landing: down on bent knees, the left hand fanning the fumes from his face.

amb.hop_ready._comment: Broom Hops' tell: crouched, the staff brought down level at his right hip with its head forward and the left hand on it behind the right, ready to hop on.

amb.hop_load._comment: Broom Hops, loaded: the knees deep, the body low over the staff, the eyes on the landing.

amb.hop_air._comment: Broom Hops in the air: perched side-saddle on the staff (the seat of broom.saddle), the right hand holding it exactly where the broom rides when he flies, the left arm out for balance.

amb.hop_land._comment: Broom Hops' landing: down on deep knees, the staff swung forward and down, the splash at his feet.

amb.glasses._comment: Pushing his glasses up the bridge of his nose with a finger of the left hand, the staff upright in the right.

amb.brew_set._comment: Great Brew's tell: the staff held out before him and tipped forward so the cauldron hangs at his waist, the left hand over it, the knees bent.

amb.brew_stir._comment: Great Brew, the channel: leaning in over the cauldron, the left hand stirring the brew in circles, the face lit from below.

amb.brew_heave._comment: Great Brew, the heave: the staff hauled up in both hands, the cauldron swinging up beside his right shoulder.

amb.brew_fling._comment: Great Brew, the fling: the staff thrust up at the sky, the cauldron tipped empty high before him, the body arched back, the head thrown back.

amb.brew_watch._comment: Great Brew, the rain: the staff held up at his right, the left hand shading his eyes as he watches the splashes fall.

amb.ult_take._comment: Grand Experiment: the staff taken in both hands before his chest, the cauldron swinging.

amb.ult_lift._comment: Grand Experiment's tell: the cauldron lifted high on the staff at his right, the left arm flung out wide, the chest arched and the eyes up on it while the crow caws.

amb.ult_cock._comment: Grand Experiment, drawn back: the staff tipped back over his right shoulder, the body coiled back and trembling.

amb.ult_fling._comment: Grand Experiment's release: the staff swept forward and up, the cauldron flinging its brew at the sky before him ('Hypothesis: you lose!').

amb.ult_swirl._comment: Grand Experiment, the rain: the staff held high and swung round in a slow circle, the cauldron sloshing over the falling splashes, the left hand out.

amb.bar_lob_x._comment: Potion Barrage, just after the release: the lob's follow-through with the vial gone.

amb.fume_smash_x._comment: Fume Step, just after the vial broke: the arm still down, the vial gone.

amb.hop_drop._comment: Broom Hops, coming down: the legs reaching for the ground under him, the staff swinging forward off his seat.

amb.p3_bow._comment: Phase 3, gathering: the head bowed so the hat's brim (turned down again) hides his eyes, the staff drawn in, the left hand at the brim's edge.

amb.p3_rise._comment: Phase 3, the reveal: the head snapped up with the eyes glowing green, the left hand flicking the brim up, the staff raised.

amb.p3_hold._comment: Phase 3, settled: the brim up, the staff ready, the left hand open at his side.

amb.intro_tip._comment: The intro: the left hand at the front of his hat's brim, tipping it, the head bowed a little in greeting.

amb.intro_present._comment: The intro: the left hand opened palm up toward the challenger ('Ah, a test subject! I mean, a guest.'), the head tilted.

amb.vic_cheer._comment: The victory: the staff thrust up high in the right hand, the left fist pumped before his chest ('Eureka!').

amb.vic_note._comment: The victory: the notebook held up in the left hand before his face, reading back the result with a pleased nod ('Data acquired.'), the staff upright.

amb.taunt_peer._comment: The taunt: leaning in, peering at the enemy over his glasses with the left hand at their rim, the head tilted.

amb.taunt_wag._comment: The taunt: upright, the left forefinger raised and wagging before him ('Hold still, please').

amb.ls_slump._comment: The last stand: bent over, panting, the staff planted, the left hand on his knee.

amb.ls_ready._comment: The last stand: straight up with the staff raised and a vial ready in the left hand, the jaw set ('Very well. One last experiment.').

amb.esc_clutch._comment: The escape: the right hand clutching his hat to his head, a glance back over the shoulder.

amb.esc_wave._comment: The escape: the left hand flapped back at the pursuer ('Don't touch my notes!').

amb.note_write._comment: Field notes: the notebook open in the left hand before his chest, the pencil in the right scribbling on it, the head bowed to read.

amb.note_think._comment: Field notes: the pencil tapped against his chin, the eyes turned up, thinking.

amb.vial_look._comment: Vial shake: a vial held up at eye level in the left hand, squinted at through his glasses.

amb.vial_sky._comment: Vial shake: the vial lifted toward the light, the head tilted back to look up through it.

amb.vial_stow._comment: Vial shake: the vial tucked back into the bandolier on his chest.

amb.crow_look._comment: The crow's peck: the head turned up and to his left at the crow on his hat, the left shoulder hitched to shoo it.

amb.cau_swing._comment: Cauldron, on the way down: the staff swung out to his right side before it comes forward, so its foot passes clear of his body.

amb.p2_crow_up._comment: amb.hop_air with the crow off its perch.

amb.p2_crow_flap._comment: amb.hop_air with the crow off its perch.

amb.vic_cheer_c._comment: amb.vic_cheer with the crow off its perch.

amb.peck_hop._comment: amb.crow_look with the crow off its perch.

amb.peck_up._comment: amb.crow_look with the crow off its perch.

amb.peck_hit._comment: amb.crow_look with the crow off its perch.

amb.peck_shoo._comment: amb.crow_look with the crow off its perch.

amb.peck_down._comment: amb.crow_look with the crow off its perch.

amb.ride_seat._comment: broom.saddle with the crow off its perch.

amb.ride_hop._comment: broom.hop with the crow off its perch.

amb.land_hop._comment: broom.hop with the crow off its perch.

move.potion_barrage.description: Potion Barrage (move slot 0, a barrage of 3 vials 0.4 s apart, light: 0.6 / 0.8 / 0.8 s): three underhand lobs with the left hand, kept low so the arm never sweeps through the crow on his shoulder. Each time the hand plucks a vial from the bandolier on his chest (the vial slides out of his fingers), swings it back past his left hip with the chest turned away and lobs it forward and up (hit and the throw sound at 0.50, 0.90 and 1.30 s: ticks 12, 20 and 28, the barrage's own 8-tick spacing); after the third his hand pats along the empty loops, the head bowed to look, reaching for new vials, and he is back on guard by 2.15 s. Upper body and left arm only: the staff stays in the right hand as the base carries it, so the clip plays over his stance and over the broom alike.

move.cauldron.description: Cauldron (move slot 1, a pool at the target, area: 1.0 / 0.05 / 0.8 s): the staff swung up high at his right so the cauldron rides above his head, swirled round twice like a censer while the knees soften and the left hand conducts (the tell: the disc grows under the target); then the staff is swung forward and down one-handed, the cauldron out before him at chest height flinging its brew, the left palm thrown out after it at the target (hit at 0.90 s, tick 20; cast 0.95, tick 21); the cauldron dips on, and he straightens back to his guard by 1.8 s. Feet planted.

move.hex_mark.description: Hex Mark (move slot 2, a bolt, light: 0.5 / 0.05 / 0.4 s): the left hand comes up before his chest with two fingers raised, tracing the hex in a quick circle (0.15 s), is cocked back beside his cheek, and flicked out straight at the target with the fingers spread (hit and the hex sound at 0.40 s, tick 10; cast 0.45, tick 11); held a beat with a sly smile, back on guard by 0.9 s. Upper body and left arm only (it plays over the broom too).

move.fume_step.description: Fume Step (move slot 3, a hop back 5 and a nova of fumes where he stood, light: 0.4 / 0.05 / 0.4 s): down on bent knees with a vial snatched up to his shoulder (0.12 s), dashed at his feet (hit and the fume sound at 0.30 s, tick 8; cast 0.35, tick 9) as the knees load; the hop back (the server carries him 5 blocks) with the knees tucked up and the body over them, the left hand waving the fumes off, down on bent knees at 0.6 s, fanning his face, back on guard by 0.8 s.

move.broom_hops.description: Broom Hops (move slot 4, phases 2-3, a leap of 8 that lands in a slowing puddle and follows itself twice, heavy: 0.8 / 0.5 / 0.8 s): the staff brought down level at his right hip, head forward, as he crouches (0.25 s), then sinks deeper over it, the eyes on the landing (the tell; the crow caws on the server); the hop (hit and the broom sound at 0.70 s, tick 16): up side-saddle on the staff held under him exactly where the broom rides when he flies, the left arm out for balance; down on deep knees with the staff swung forward (cast at 1.15 s, tick 25: the splash and the puddle; the next hop starts here), up again pushing his glasses into place, back on guard by 2.0 s.

move.great_brew.description: Great Brew (move slot 5, phase 3, a 3 s channel that breaks at 15%, then a rain of 10 over 2 s, area: 1.0 / 5.0 / 2.0 s): the staff tipped forward so the cauldron hangs before his waist, the left hand over it (the tell, to 0.9 s: hit, tick 20, the channel begins); bent low over the cauldron he stirs it in quick circles for 3 s, bobbing with the boil ('Big one coming, please don't interrupt!'; the server loops the boil); at 3.75 s he hauls the staff up beside his shoulder and at 3.9 s (tick 80) thrusts it at the sky, the cauldron tipped empty, arched back, the rain beginning; he watches the splashes fall with the staff held high and the left hand shading his eyes (cast at 5.85 s, tick 119); lowers the staff, pushes his glasses up with a satisfied grin, and is back on guard by 7.9 s.

ultimate.description: Grand Experiment (the ultimate: a rain of 12 over 3 s, 1.6 / 3.0 / 1.5 s): the staff taken up before him (0.3 s) and the cauldron lifted high at his right, the left arm flung wide and the chest arched while the crow on his shoulder spreads its wings and caws (the tell); the staff drawn back over his shoulder, trembling (1.25 s), and swept forward and up so the cauldron flings its brew at the sky ('Hypothesis: you lose!'; hit at 1.50 s, tick 32); while the rain falls he swings the cauldron round high in slow circles, laughing (cast at 4.45 s, tick 91: the rain's end); the staff lowered, the glasses pushed up with a grin and an 'a-ha!', back on guard by 6.0 s. Upper body only (he may wind it up in the air).

phase.2.description: Phase 2 (inside the 1.2 s transition, 'Fascinating! Let's test mobility!'): broom bristles have burst from the staff's foot; he swings it down level and stares at them with delight (the bristles sound at 0.15 s), crouches and hops up side-saddle onto it for a test perch (0.55 s) while the crow flaps up off his shoulder in alarm, drops back to his feet (0.9 s) and is on guard by 1.1 s with a happy face.

phase.3.description: Phase 3 (inside the 1.2 s transition, 'Time for the big one. Please don't interrupt.'): the head bows so the hat's brim, turned down, hides his eyes, the staff drawn in and the shoulders trembling (0.15-0.5 s); the head snaps up with the eyes glowing green as the left hand flicks the brim up (the glow sound at 0.62 s; the brim overshoots and settles lifted), the staff raised, then on guard by 1.1 s. The lifted brim is the phase look (headwear/witch_brim_up): this clip only turns it.

intro.description: The intro (the server holds it as long as the clip, 'Ah, a test subject! I mean, a guest. Hold still, please.'): the left hand to the front of his hat's brim and the hat tipped with a little bow (the intro sound at 0.25 s), the glasses pushed up his nose (0.8 s), then the left hand opened palm up toward the challenger with the head tilted, and back on guard by 1.5 s.

victory.description: The victory ('Data acquired.'): the staff thrust up and the left fist pumped with an 'a-ha!' (0.3 s) while the crow spreads its wings; then the notebook comes out of his left hand and is held up to read the result back, with two pleased nods, put away, and the staff lowered by 2.0 s.

taunt.description: The taunt ('Hold still, please.'): he leans in peering at the enemy over the rim of his glasses with the head tilted (0.3 s), then straightens and wags a raised forefinger at them, tutting, back on guard by 1.5 s.

last_stand.description: The last stand (cornered, or caught again within ten minutes): bent over with the staff planted and a hand on his knee, panting (to 0.6 s), then up straight, the glasses pushed up, the staff raised and a vial ready in the left hand with the jaw set ('Very well. One last experiment.'), on guard by 1.6 s.

escape.description: The escape, over the run (or the broom as he takes off), 0.6 s ('Experiment concluded! Result: I should leave. Don't touch my notes!'): the right hand clutches his hat to his head and he glances back over his shoulder, the left hand flapped back at the pursuer, then the arms back into the run. Upper body only.

personal.1.description: Notebook scribble (an idle quirk, 3.0 s): the notebook comes out of his left hand and the pencil out of his right; he scribbles with his head bowed over the page (the scribble sound at 0.65 s), stops to tap the pencil on his chin with his eyes turned up, writes a last line with a little nod and puts both away.

personal.2.description: Vial shake (an idle quirk, 2.6 s): a vial comes out of his left hand and is held up at eye level, squinted at through the glasses, shaken briskly by the ear (the slosh at 0.75 s), lifted toward the light with the head tipped back, then tucked away into the bandolier with a satisfied pat.

personal.3.description: The crow pecks his hat (an idle quirk, 3.0 s): the crow hops from his shoulder up onto the hat's brim and pecks the crown three times (the peck at 0.55 s); he turns his head up at it with a frown and hitches his shoulder to shoo it, the crow flaps off the brim, settles back on his shoulder, and he sighs with his eyes closed.

move.ride.description: Riding the broom side-saddle, a 2.0 s loop: a gentle bob with the broom (the mount bone rides under the root), the crossed ankles swinging idly, the free hand on the knee. His crow flaps along beside him, off his left shoulder, its wings beating four times a second and bobbing on the air.

move.takeoff.description: Take-off on the broom, 0.6 s, the tell: a crouch (0.15 s), a hop with the knees lifted and the body turning (0.3 s; the staff appears on the mount bone under him), settling side-saddle onto the shaft by 0.6 s. The server plays the take-off cue and Ambrose's broom take-off (SOUND.md 7). The crow lifts off his shoulder at the hop and takes its place beside him.

move.fly_land.description: Landing from the broom, 0.4 s: he slides off the shaft, the legs swinging down (0.15 s), the feet touch (0.25 s) and he stands (0.4 s); the engine then puts the staff back in his hand. The crow drops back onto his shoulder and folds its wings as he stands.

sec.loop.description: The crow's glances on the secondary controller, a 6.0 s loop: it looks about from his shoulder (to his face, out to the side, a curious tilt, down at the ground), a quick head-turn each time with a hold between. Keys only crow_head's rotation.
